headline: French deficit widens, PM Lecornu delays hopes to reach 5% of GDP in 2027
description: France's deficit is expected to rise to 5.4% of GDP in 2026, far from the 5% target, the government acknowledged on Thursday. After this setback, the prime minister hopes to regain control of public finances in 2027, but economists remain skeptical.

headline: Thierry Chopin, political scientist: 'Amid the current upheaval in international relations, Canada and the EU need to move closer together'
description: While there is no doubt that the European Union and Canada share many common interests, the challenge remains to invent a framework that gives this partnership both ambitious and realistic substance, argues the political scientist in this opinion piece for Le Monde.

headline: Eiffel Tower director faces turmoil after sidelining of female staff at request of Hindu delegation
description: The exclusion of female staff members during a visit by members of an ultra-conservative Hindu religious group, sparked a strike and two investigations.
